text_simplified: The text discusses the tarbiyah (upbringing) of daughters upon khayr (goodness) and akhlaq (virtuous character), with emphasis on teaching them acts of worship, charity, and dialogue. It highlights the role of the mother in guiding her daughter toward good behavior, the importance of listening to her, and encouraging her to speak. It also mentions that a young girl learns from her parents' actions, and that the tarbiyah of daughters requires special attention.
